From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: FintechCorp security discovery: incident response & BCP evidence

Hi Alice / Bob  thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

1) What we heard from you
- You want confirmation of SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA posture, and evidence around incident response / breach notification timelines.
- Procurement will need answers to the vendor security questionnaire and a few supporting artifacts (SOC2 summary, BCP/DR evidence).

2) Actions / asks for FintechCorp
- Please attach your vendor security questionnaire (if you have one) so we can fill it out.
- Can you confirm the expected timeline for breach notification to your customers (e.g., your SLA for notifying affected parties once an incident is confirmed)?
- Any specific evidence you want for BCP/DR tests (RTO/RPO targets, DR test reports, tabletop exercise summaries)?

3) What we'll provide
- I’ll loop in Marissa (security) to coordinate SOC2 artifacts and BCP evidence. We can provide a Redwood SOC2 summary and recent DR test artifacts.
- If helpful, we can provide answers in the questionnaire and a short one-page incident response timeline summary (detection -> containment -> root cause/forensics -> notification).

Proposed next steps: 
- Alice/Bob: send the vendor questionnaire and confirm procurement timeline for contracting (target close date).
- Marissa: I’m looping you in to pick this up from here.

Thanks  happy to jump back on a quick call if that’s easier.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

[Attachment note: we can provide Redwood SOC2 summary & BCP evidence once we get the questionnaire and procurement timeline]

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechcorp.com>

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCorp security discovery: incident response & BCP evidence

Jordan  thanks for the recap and for looping Marissa in. 

I've attached our vendor security questionnaire (FinTechCorp_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx) and a short SOC 2 summary for our records (FinTechCorp_SOC2_summary.pdf) so you can see the level of detail procurement will expect. A few answers inline: 

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II in 2025 and perform annual audits.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We process personal data for EU customers and maintain data processing addenda where required; HIPAA applies for a subset of customers and we have BAAs with covered customers.
- Incident response & breach notification: Our internal detection targets are within 1 hour; containment goals are 24 hours for system-level incidents. For incidents involving personal data we contractually require vendors to notify us within 72 hours of confirming a breach so we can meet regulatory obligations.

Procurement note: please return the questionnaire to procurement@fintechcorp.com. Our procurement team is targeting vendor sign-off by Aug 20. 

Attachments: FinTechCorp_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx

Best,
Alice Chen
Security & Compliance Manager | FintechCorp
alice.chen@fintechcorp.com
